description: This file defines an interface IPlacementContext which provides methods and properties related to the placement of grains within a silo network, including obtaining compatible silos and local silo information.

methods.name: GetCompatibleSilos
methods.description: Returns silos compatible with the specified placement target.

methods.name: GetCompatibleSilosWithVersions
methods.description: Returns silos compatible with the specified placement target along with supported grain interface versions.
